en.B: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
en.R: A song with music, from the family of Korah.

fr.B: Un cantique. Un psaume des fils de Coré.
fr.R: Un chant avec musique, de la famille de Coré.

sw.B: Wimbo. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora.

pt.B: Cântico. Salmo dos filhos de Corá.
pt.R: Uma canção com música, da família de Corá.

hi.L: गीत। कोरह के पुत्रों का भजन।
hi.B: गीत। कोरह के पुत्रों का भजन।
hi.R: संगीत के साथ गाने का गीत, कोरह के परिवार का।

ru.R: Песня с музыкой, из семьи Корея.

ja.R: 楽器に合わせて歌う、コラの一族の歌。

uk.R: Пісня з музикою від родини Корея.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the sons of Korah: a family of Levite singers
decisions.reason: The descendants of Korah, a Levite (Numbers 26:11), served as gatekeepers and singers at the temple (1 Chronicles 9:19; 2 Chronicles 20:19). Eleven psalms carry their name (42-49, 84-85, 87-88). "Of" may mean the psalm belongs to their collection or was written by one of them.

decisions.choice: a song, a psalm: two words for a song
decisions.reason: Song (shir) is the general word; psalm (mizmor) is a song sung to music (3:1). The two stand together in several titles (30:1; 65:1).

decisions.choice: a song with music
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two words into one plain phrase (m2).

decisions.choice: Readable "음악에 맞춘 노래" for the pair shir and mizmor
decisions.reason: Both words name a song (meaning decision m3); Readable says it once, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: गीत; भजन (L, B); संगीत के साथ गाने का गीत (R)
decisions.reason: Shir is गीत and mizmor भजन, as in the table for the titles; Readable joins the two words into one plain phrase, as the English does. The Korah title is as in 42:1.

decisions.choice: "сыновей Корея" (L, B), "из семьи Корея" (R)
decisions.reason: The title words have one form through the Korah psalms (42-49) as the poetry note gives them: "Руководителю хора" (L, B), "Для руководителя музыкантов" (R); "маскиль" kept as a term at Literal and Balanced, "песня, чтобы учить" at Readable; and "сыновей Корея" (L, B), "из семьи Корея" (R), with Korah in the form of Numbers 16 (Корей). This title uses them as in 42:1.

decisions.choice: "Песнь. Псалом" (L, B); "Песня с музыкой" (R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's words for shir and mizmor; Readable joins them into one plain phrase, as the English does.

decisions.choice: shir mizmor "歌。…賛歌" (L, B), "楽器に合わせて歌う…歌" (R, as the English R "a song with music")
decisions.reason: The Psalter's title words (PSA-1: shir 歌, mizmor 賛歌 L, B / 歌 R); two words for a song (m3).

source.text: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַר־קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Great [is] YHWH and to be praised exceedingly in [the] city of our God, [the] mountain of his holiness.

en.L: Great [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, the mountain of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great and deserves all praise in the city of our God, on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy mountain.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great! In our God's city, on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy mountain, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} deserves all our praise.

fr.L: Grand [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et très digne de louange dans la ville de notre Dieu, la montagne de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand et mérite toute louange dans la ville de notre Dieu, sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} montagne sainte.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand ! Dans la ville de notre Dieu, sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} montagne sainte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mérite toutes nos louanges.

sw.L: Mkuu [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na wa kusifiwa sana katika mji wa Mungu wetu, mlima wa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu, anastahili sifa zote katika mji wa Mungu wetu, juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu! Katika mji wa Mungu wetu, juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anastahili sifa zetu zote.

es.L: Grande [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y muy digno de alabanza en la ciudad de nuestro Dios, el monte de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santidad.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande y merece toda alabanza en la ciudad de nuestro Dios, en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} monte santo.
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande! En la ciudad de nuestro Dios, en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} monte santo, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} merece toda nuestra alabanza.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] vĩ đại và rất đáng được ca ngợi trong thành của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại và đáng được mọi lời ca ngợi trong thành của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại! Trong thành của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được chúng ta hết lòng ca ngợi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고, 우리 하나님의 성, 그분의 거룩한 산에서 크게 찬양받으실 [분이시다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 위대하시니, 우리 하나님의 성, 그분의 거룩한 산에서 모든 찬양을 받으시기에 마땅하시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 위대하시다! 우리 하나님의 성, 그분의 거룩한 산에서 그분은 우리의 모든 찬양을 받으셔야 마땅하다.

pt.L: Grande [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e sumamente louvável na cidade do nosso Deus, o monte da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santidade.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é grande e merece todo louvor na cidade do nosso Deus, no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo monte.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é grande! Na cidade do nosso Deus, no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo monte, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} merece todo o nosso louvor.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ [ነው]፤ በአምላካችን ከተማ፣ በቅድስናው ተራራ እጅግ ሊመሰገን የሚገባው [ነው]።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነው፤ በአምላካችን ከተማ፣ በተቀደሰው ተራራው ላይ ምስጋና ሁሉ ይገባዋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነው! በአምላካችን ከተማ፣ በተቀደሰው ተራራው ላይ ምስጋናችን ሁሉ ይገባዋል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान [हैं] और हमारे परमेश्वर की नगरी में, उनकी पवित्रता के पर्वत पर, अत्यंत स्तुति के योग्य [हैं]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं और हमारे परमेश्वर के नगर में, अपने पवित्र पर्वत पर, सारी स्तुति के योग्य हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं! हमारे परमेश्वर के नगर में, उनके पवित्र पर्वत पर, वे हमारी सारी स्तुति के योग्य हैं।

ru.L: Велик {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} и весьма достоин хвалы в городе Бога нашего, [на] горе святости {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик и достоин всякой хвалы в городе нашего Бога, на {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святой горе.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик! В городе нашего Бога, на {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святой горе, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} достоин всей нашей хвалы.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は大いなる方、大いに賛美されるべき方、わたしたちの神の都、その聖なる山で。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な方。わたしたちの神の都、その聖なる山で、大いに賛美されるにふさわしい。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な方だ！わたしたちの神の都で、その聖なる山で、その方は、わたしたちのあらゆる賛美を受けるにふさわしい。

uk.L: Великий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} і вельми гідний хвали в місті нашого Бога, на горі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святості.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий і гідний усякої хвали в місті нашого Бога, на {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святій горі.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий! У місті нашого Бога, на {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святій горі, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} гідний усієї нашої хвали.

decisions.choice: the city of our God: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Like Psalm 46, this is a song of Zion: Jerusalem, where God chose to live, praised for the God who defends it.

decisions.choice: his holy mountain: the end of verse 2
alternatives: the start of a sentence in verse 3: "His holy mountain, beautiful in height, ..."
decisions.reason: The phrase can close verse 2, as the Hebrew verse division has it, or begin the description of Zion in verse 3. The meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: to be praised exceedingly: worthy of all praise
decisions.reason: The form (mehullal) means "praised" or "to be praised" (18:4).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; नगरी (L), नगर (B, R)
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans, as in English
decisions.reason: Hindi has no capital letters; God is set apart by तू in address and honorific forms (वे, उनकी) in the third person, so the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans in this psalm. As in Psalm 46, Literal calls the city नगरी, keeping the Hebrew's feminine "her", and Balanced and Readable say नगर.

decisions.choice: "その聖なる山で" closes 48:2 at every level
decisions.reason: The verse division is uncertain (m2); the English reading, with the holy mountain at the end of 48:2, is kept. Worthy of all praise (m3).

source.text: יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֪וֹשׂ כָּל־הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ הַר־צִ֭יּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Beautiful [in] height, [the] joy of all the earth, Mount Zion, [the] far reaches of Zaphon, [the] town of [the] great King.

en.L: Beautiful [in] height, the joy of all the earth, [is] Mount Zion, the far reaches of Zaphon, the city of the great King.
en.B: Mount Zion rises in beauty, the delight of the whole earth; it is the true heights of Zaphon, the great King's city.
en.R: Mount Zion is high and beautiful. It brings joy to the whole world. It is the real mountain of God, the city of the great King.

fr.L: Belle [en] hauteur, la joie de toute la terre, [c’est] le mont Sion, les extrémités du Tsaphon, la cité du grand Roi.
fr.B: Le mont Sion s’élève dans sa beauté, la joie de toute la terre ; il est les vraies hauteurs du Tsaphon, la cité du grand Roi.
fr.R: Le mont Sion est haut et beau. Il donne de la joie au monde entier. C’est la vraie montagne de Dieu, la ville du grand Roi.

sw.L: Mzuri [kwa] kimo, furaha ya dunia yote, [ni] Mlima Sayuni, pande za mbali za Safoni, mji wa Mfalme mkuu.
sw.B: Mlima Sayuni umeinuka kwa uzuri, furaha ya dunia nzima; ndio vilele halisi vya Safoni, mji wa Mfalme mkuu.
sw.R: Mlima Sayuni ni mrefu na mzuri. Unaleta furaha kwa ulimwengu wote. Ndio mlima halisi wa Mungu, mji wa Mfalme mkuu.

es.L: Hermoso [en] altura, la alegría de toda la tierra, [es] el monte Sion, los confines de Zafón, la ciudad del gran Rey.
es.B: El monte Sion se alza hermoso, delicia de toda la tierra; es la verdadera cumbre de Zafón, la ciudad del gran Rey.
es.R: El monte Sion es alto y hermoso. Llena de alegría al mundo entero. Es el verdadero monte de Dios, la ciudad del gran Rey.

vi.L: Đẹp đẽ [trên] cao, niềm vui của cả trái đất, [là] núi Si-ôn, nơi tận cùng của Xa-phôn, thành của Vua vĩ đại.
vi.B: Núi Si-ôn vươn lên đẹp đẽ, là niềm vui của cả trái đất; đó chính là đỉnh Xa-phôn thật, thành của Vua vĩ đại.
vi.R: Núi Si-ôn cao và đẹp. Núi ấy đem niềm vui cho cả thế giới. Đó là núi thật của Đức Chúa Trời, thành của Vua vĩ đại.

ko.L: 높이 솟아 아름다운 [곳], 온 땅의 기쁨, 시온산, 북쪽 끝, 큰 왕의 성[이다].
ko.B: 시온산은 아름답게 솟아 있어 온 땅의 기쁨이 되니, 참된 북쪽 끝 산이요 위대한 왕의 성이다.
ko.R: 시온산은 높고 아름답다. 온 세상에 기쁨을 준다. 그곳이야말로 하나님의 참된 산이요, 위대한 왕의 성이다.

pt.L: Bela [em] altura, a alegria de toda a terra, [é] o monte Sião, os confins de Zafom, a cidade do grande Rei.
pt.B: O monte Sião se ergue em beleza, a alegria de toda a terra; ele é o verdadeiro alto de Zafom, a cidade do grande Rei.
pt.R: O monte Sião é alto e bonito. Ele traz alegria ao mundo inteiro. Ele é o verdadeiro monte de Deus, a cidade do grande Rei.

am.L: በከፍታ ያማረ፣ የምድር ሁሉ ደስታ የጽዮን ተራራ፣ የጻፎን ዳርቻዎች፣ የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ [ነው]።
am.B: የጽዮን ተራራ በውበት ከፍ ብሎ ይታያል፤ የምድር ሁሉ ደስታ ነው፤ እውነተኛው የጻፎን ከፍታ፣ የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ ነው።
am.R: የጽዮን ተራራ ከፍ ያለና ውብ ነው። ለዓለም ሁሉ ደስታን ያመጣል። እውነተኛው የእግዚአብሔር ተራራ፣ የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ ነው።

hi.L: ऊँचाई में सुंदर, सारी पृथ्वी का आनंद, सिय्योन पर्वत [है], सापोन के दूर के छोर, महान राजा की नगरी।
hi.B: सिय्योन पर्वत सुंदरता से ऊँचा उठा है, सारी पृथ्वी का आनंद; यही सापोन की सच्ची ऊँचाई है, महान राजा का नगर।
hi.R: सिय्योन पर्वत ऊँचा और सुंदर है। वह सारे संसार को आनंद देता है। वही परमेश्वर का सच्चा पर्वत है, महान राजा का नगर।

ru.L: Прекрасна высотой, радость всей земли — гора Сион, дальние высоты Цафона, город великого Царя.
ru.B: Гора Сион возвышается во всей красе, радость всей земли; она — истинные высоты Цафона, город великого Царя.
ru.R: Гора Сион высокая и красивая. Она приносит радость всему миру. Это настоящая Божья гора, город великого Царя.

ja.L: 高さにおいて麗しく、全地の喜び[であるのは]シオンの山、ツァフォンの果て、大いなる王の都。
ja.B: シオンの山は麗しくそびえ、全地の喜び。それは、まことのツァフォンのはるかな高み、偉大な王の都。
ja.R: シオンの山は高く、美しい。全世界に喜びを与える。それは本当の神の山、偉大な王の都。

uk.L: Прекрасна [у] височині, радість усієї землі — гора Сіон, далекі краї Цафону, місто великого Царя.
uk.B: Гора Сіон височіє в красі, утіха всієї землі; це справжні вершини Цафону, місто великого Царя.
uk.R: Гора Сіон висока й гарна. Вона приносить радість усьому світові. Це справжня Божа гора, місто великого Царя.

decisions.choice: the far reaches of Zaphon: the true mountain of God
decisions.reason: Zaphon means "north", and it was also the name of a mountain north of Israel that Israel's neighbors held to be the home of their gods (compare Isaiah 14:13). Zion is not in the far north; the psalm says that Zion, not Zaphon, is where the true God lives.

decisions.choice: the city of the great King: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The great King is God (47:3). Jesus calls Jerusalem "the city of the great King" in Matthew 5:35.

decisions.choice: height: elevation
decisions.reason: The word (nof) occurs only here; it seems to mean height. Zion is not the highest hill, but it is the highest in honor.

decisions.choice: the real mountain of God
decisions.reason: Readable says what naming Zaphon means (m1) instead of using a name readers would not know.

decisions.choice: "Tsaphon" for the mountain's name at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The word names both the north and a mountain held to be the home of the gods (meaning decision m1). French keeps it as a name, spelled to show its sound; Readable says what naming it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Xa-phôn" kept as a name (L, B); "núi thật của Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: Zaphon was the name of a mountain held to be the home of the gods; the psalm says Zion is the true one (see the meaning decision). Readable gives that sense, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "북쪽 끝" (the far north) for the far reaches of Zaphon; Readable "하나님의 참된 산"
decisions.reason: Zaphon was the northern mountain where neighboring peoples said the gods lived; Zion is the true mountain of God (meaning decision m1). "북쪽" gives the word's plain meaning; Readable says what the picture means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Zafom
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the mountain's name (m1) in its Portuguese spelling, since the point is that Zion, not Zafom, is the home of the true God; Readable says this, as the English Readable does. "A cidade do grande Rei" is worded as in the Portuguese of Matthew 5:35 (m2).

decisions.choice: Zaphon as the name "ጻፎን"; "the city of the great King" as "የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ", the words of Matthew 5:35
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads Zaphon as the mountain of the gods, set against Zion, so it stays a name at Literal and Balanced; Readable explains it, as the English does. Jesus' words in Matthew 5:35 already have "የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ" in Amharic.

decisions.choice: सापोन
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep Zaphon as a name, as the English does, spelled सापोन as the place in Joshua 13:27; Readable says what naming it means, the true mountain of God, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Цафона" kept as a name
decisions.reason: Zaphon is the name of the mountain where the gods were said to live; naming Zion so makes it the true mountain of God (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the name as the English does; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: yarketei tsafon "ツァフォンの果て" (L), "まことのツァフォンのはるかな高み" (B), "本当の神の山" (R); qiryat melekh rav "大いなる王の都" (L), "偉大な王の都" (B, R) as MAT 5:35
decisions.reason: Zaphon as ISA 14:13 (ISA-1 notes), here the true mountain of God (m1, uncertain, footnoted); Jesus quotes "the city of the great King" (m2), and the Matthew Japanese is followed at each level.

decisions.choice: "Цафон" kept as a name
decisions.reason: Zaphon is the mountain of the gods in Canaanite poetry, and the psalm claims its title for Zion; the name form is the one the Ukrainian Exodus and Joshua drafts use for the place.

records.literal_gloss: God, in her fortresses, has made himself known as a high refuge.

en.L: God, in her fortresses, has made {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} known as a high refuge.
en.B: Within the city's strongholds God has proved {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} a high refuge.
en.R: God is in the city's strong towers. He has shown that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps it safe.

fr.L: Dieu, dans ses palais fortifiés, s’est fait connaître comme une haute retraite.
fr.B: Dans les citadelles de la ville, Dieu s’est montré une haute retraite.
fr.R: Dieu est dans les tours solides de la ville. Il a montré qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la garde en sécurité.

sw.L: Mungu, katika ngome zake, amejijulisha {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kuwa kimbilio la juu.
sw.B: Ndani ya ngome za mji Mungu amejionyesha {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kuwa kimbilio la juu.
sw.R: Mungu yuko katika minara imara ya mji. Ameonyesha kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye anayeulinda.

es.L: Dios, en sus fortalezas, se ha dado a conocer como alto refugio.
es.B: Dentro de las fortalezas de la ciudad, Dios ha demostrado ser un alto refugio.
es.R: Dios está en las torres fuertes de la ciudad. Él ha mostrado que la mantiene a salvo.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời, trong các đồn lũy của thành, đã tự bày tỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là nơi ẩn náu trên cao.
vi.B: Trong các đồn lũy của thành, Đức Chúa Trời đã chứng tỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là nơi ẩn náu trên cao.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời ở trong các tháp kiên cố của thành. Ngài đã cho thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ thành được an toàn.

ko.L: 하나님께서 그 성의 요새들 안에서 높은 피난처로 자신을 알리셨다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 그 성의 요새들 안에서 높은 피난처이심을 드러내셨다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 그 성의 튼튼한 망대들 안에 계신다. 그분께서 그 성을 안전하게 지키신다는 것을 보여 주셨다.

pt.L: Deus, nas fortalezas dela, é conhecido como alto refúgio.
pt.B: Nas fortalezas da cidade Deus mostrou ser um alto refúgio.
pt.R: Deus está nas torres fortes da cidade. Ele mostrou que a protege.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር በምሽጎቿ ውስጥ ከፍ ያለ መጠጊያ ሆኖ ራሱን ገለጠ።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር በከተማዪቱ ምሽጎች ውስጥ ከፍ ያለ መጠጊያ መሆኑን አሳየ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር በከተማዪቱ ጠንካራ ግንቦች ውስጥ ነው። በደኅና እንደሚጠብቃት አሳይቷል።

hi.L: परमेश्वर ने उसके गढ़ों में अपने आप को ऊँचे गढ़ के रूप में प्रकट किया है।
hi.B: नगर के गढ़ों के भीतर परमेश्वर ने अपने आप को ऊँचा गढ़ सिद्ध किया है।
hi.R: परमेश्वर नगर की मज़बूत मीनारों में हैं। उन्होंने दिखा दिया है कि वे उसकी रक्षा करते हैं।

ru.L: Бог в её крепостях явил себя высоким прибежищем.
ru.B: В крепостях города Бог показал себя надёжным прибежищем на высоте.
ru.R: Бог — в крепких башнях города. Он показал, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хранит его.

ja.L: 神は、その[都の]城塞の中で、ご自分を高い砦として知らせられた。
ja.B: 都の城塞の中で、神はご自分が高い砦であることを示された。
ja.R: 神は、都の堅固な塔の中におられる。その方は、ご自分が都を守ってくださることを示された。

uk.L: Бог у її твердинях виявив себе як висока твердиня.
uk.B: У міських твердинях Бог показав себе високим притулком.
uk.R: Бог — у міцних вежах міста. Він показав, що береже його.

decisions.choice: fortresses: the strong buildings of the city
decisions.reason: The word ('armon) means a fortified building, a citadel or palace.

decisions.choice: a high refuge: God, not the walls
decisions.reason: The city's safety is not in its strong buildings but in God who is in them (46:8).

decisions.choice: the city's
decisions.reason: As in 46:6.

decisions.choice: "себя" without a span
decisions.reason: The English capitalises "himself" under the setting; the Russian reflexive "себя" takes none (style guide 7b).

decisions.choice: 'armenoteiha "城塞" (L, B), "堅固な塔" (R); misgav "高い砦" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The strong buildings of the city (m1); the high refuge is God, not the walls (m2). misgav by the Psalter's refuge words.

records.literal_gloss: For look, the kings assembled; they passed on together.

en.L: For look, the kings assembled; they passed on together.
en.B: Look: the kings gathered their armies and marched on together.
en.R: Kings brought their armies together and came to attack the city.

fr.L: Car voici, les rois se sont réunis ; ils ont avancé ensemble.
fr.B: Voyez : les rois ont rassemblé leurs armées et ont marché ensemble.
fr.R: Des rois ont réuni leurs armées et sont venus attaquer la ville.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, wafalme walikusanyika; walipita pamoja.
sw.B: Tazama: wafalme walikusanya majeshi yao, wakasonga mbele pamoja.
sw.R: Wafalme walileta majeshi yao pamoja, wakaja kuushambulia mji.

es.L: Porque he aquí, los reyes se reunieron; avanzaron juntos.
es.B: Pues bien, los reyes juntaron sus ejércitos y avanzaron juntos.
es.R: Unos reyes juntaron sus ejércitos y vinieron a atacar la ciudad.

vi.L: Vì kìa, các vua đã tụ họp; chúng cùng nhau kéo qua.
vi.B: Kìa, các vua đã tập hợp quân đội và cùng nhau tiến tới.
vi.R: Các vua đã tập hợp quân đội lại và kéo đến tấn công thành.

ko.L: 보아라, 왕들이 모였다. 그들이 함께 지나갔다.
ko.B: 보아라, 왕들이 군대를 모아 함께 진군해 왔다.
ko.R: 왕들이 군대를 모아 그 성을 치러 왔다.

pt.L: Pois eis que os reis se reuniram; avançaram juntos.
pt.B: Vejam: os reis reuniram os seus exércitos e avançaram juntos.
pt.R: Reis juntaram os seus exércitos e vieram atacar a cidade.

am.B: ተመልከቱ፤ ነገሥታቱ ሠራዊታቸውን አሰባስበው በአንድነት ገሠገሡ።
am.R: ነገሥታት ሠራዊታቸውን አሰባስበው ከተማዪቱን ሊወጉ መጡ።

hi.L: क्योंकि देखो, राजा इकट्ठे हुए; वे एक साथ आगे बढ़े।
hi.B: देखो: राजाओं ने अपनी सेनाएँ इकट्ठी कीं और एक साथ चढ़ाई की।
hi.R: राजाओं ने अपनी सेनाएँ इकट्ठी कीं और नगर पर हमला करने आए।

ru.L: Ведь вот, цари собрались; прошли вместе.
ru.B: Вот, цари собрали свои войска и вместе двинулись вперёд.
ru.R: Цари собрали свои войска и пришли напасть на город.

ja.L: まことに、ああ、王たちは集まり、共に進んで来た。
ja.B: 見なさい。王たちは軍勢を集め、共に攻め進んで来た。
ja.R: 王たちは軍勢を集めて、都を攻めに来た。

uk.L: Бо ось царі зібралися; вони пройшли разом.
uk.B: Дивіться: царі зібрали свої війська й рушили разом.
uk.R: Царі зібрали свої війська й прийшли напасти на місто.

decisions.choice: passed on: advanced together
decisions.reason: The verb ('avar) means to pass on or over. It may describe the kings advancing on the city, or passing away, but verse 6 tells of their flight, so here it is their advance.

decisions.choice: the kings: rulers allied against Zion
decisions.reason: The psalm names no event. It tells the story of kings who attack God's city and fail, as in 2:2 and 46:7, and as when Jerusalem was spared from the Assyrians (Isaiah 37).

decisions.choice: gathered their armies
decisions.reason: The kings gather to make war; Balanced and Readable name their armies.

decisions.choice: came to attack the city
decisions.reason: Readable says where they were going (m1).

decisions.choice: hinneh "ああ" (L), "見なさい" (B), dropped (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalter never renders hinneh 見よ (PSA-1); rulers allied against Zion (m2), advancing together (m1, uncertain).

source.text: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: They saw, so they were astounded; they were terrified, they hurried away.

en.L: They saw [it]; so they were astounded; they were terrified; they fled in haste.
en.B: They looked, and were stunned; they panicked and ran.
en.R: But when they saw the city, they were shocked. They were terrified and ran away.

fr.L: Eux, ils ont vu ; ainsi ils ont été stupéfaits ; ils ont été épouvantés ; ils ont fui en hâte.
fr.B: Ils ont regardé, et ils ont été frappés de stupeur ; ils ont pris peur et se sont enfuis.
fr.R: Mais quand ils ont vu la ville, ils ont été bouleversés. Ils ont eu très peur et se sont enfuis.

sw.L: Waliona [hayo]; basi wakashangaa; wakaogopa; wakakimbia kwa haraka.
sw.B: Walitazama, wakapigwa na butwaa; wakaingiwa na hofu, wakakimbia.
sw.R: Lakini walipouona mji, walishtuka. Waliogopa sana, wakakimbia.

es.L: Vieron [la ciudad]; entonces quedaron atónitos; se aterraron; huyeron a toda prisa.
es.B: Miraron, y quedaron pasmados; les entró el pánico y salieron corriendo.
es.R: Pero cuando vieron la ciudad, se quedaron asombrados. Tuvieron mucho miedo y huyeron.

vi.L: Chúng đã thấy [thành]; vậy chúng kinh ngạc; chúng kinh hoàng; chúng vội vàng chạy trốn.
vi.B: Chúng nhìn thấy và sững sờ; chúng hoảng sợ và bỏ chạy.
vi.R: Nhưng khi thấy thành, chúng bị chấn động. Chúng kinh hãi và bỏ chạy.

ko.L: 그들이 [그것을] 보고, 그래서 놀랐다. 그들이 겁에 질려 서둘러 달아났다.
ko.B: 그들은 보고 넋을 잃었고, 겁에 질려 달아났다.
ko.R: 그러나 그들은 그 성을 보고 깜짝 놀랐다. 겁에 질려 도망쳤다.

pt.L: Eles [a] viram; então ficaram atônitos; ficaram apavorados; fugiram às pressas.
pt.B: Olharam e ficaram pasmos; entraram em pânico e fugiram.
pt.R: Mas, quando viram a cidade, ficaram chocados. Ficaram apavorados e fugiram.

am.L: አዩ፤ እንዲሁ ተደነቁ፤ ደነገጡ፤ ፈጥነው ሸሹ።
am.R: ነገር ግን ከተማዪቱን ባዩ ጊዜ ደነገጡ። እጅግ ፈርተው ሸሹ።

hi.L: उन्होंने [उसे] देखा; तब वे चकित हुए; वे घबरा गए; वे उतावली से भाग गए।
hi.B: उन्होंने देखा, और दंग रह गए; वे घबराकर भाग खड़े हुए।
hi.R: पर जब उन्होंने नगर को देखा, तो वे हक्के-बक्के रह गए। वे बहुत डर गए और भाग गए।

ru.L: Они увидели — и так изумились; они ужаснулись, бросились бежать.
ru.B: Они посмотрели — и оцепенели; их охватил страх, и они побежали.
ru.R: Но когда они увидели город, они были поражены. Они пришли в ужас и убежали.

ja.L: 彼らは見た。それで、驚き、おびえ、慌てて逃げ去った。
ja.B: 彼らは見て、ぼう然とし、うろたえて逃げ出した。
ja.R: しかし、都を見ると、彼らはびっくりした。恐ろしくなって、逃げて行った。

uk.L: Вони побачили [це]; тож вони остовпіли; вони жахнулися; вони поспіхом утекли.
uk.B: Вони глянули — і остовпіли; їх охопила паніка, і вони втекли.
uk.R: Але коли вони побачили місто, то були вражені. Вони жахнулися й утекли.

decisions.choice: they saw: they saw the city and the God in it
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. What they saw is the city where God has made himself known (verse 4); they had no sooner seen it than they fled.

decisions.choice: astounded, terrified, fled: a quick collapse
decisions.reason: Four short verbs follow one another without links: they saw, were stunned, panicked, fled.

decisions.choice: the city
decisions.reason: Readable says what they saw (m1).

decisions.choice: the story of the kings (verses 5-8) in the passé composé at every level
alternatives: the passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The psalm is a song sung to God and to the people, not written narrative, so French uses the past tense of speech, as it does for the past events told in the psalms.

records.literal_gloss: Trembling seized them there, anguish like [a woman] giving birth.

en.L: Trembling seized them there, anguish like [a woman] giving birth.
en.B: There they were seized with shaking, with pangs like a woman giving birth.
en.R: They shook with fear. They were in pain like a woman having a baby.

fr.L: Un tremblement les a saisis là, une angoisse comme [celle de la femme] qui enfante.
fr.B: Là, ils ont été pris de tremblement, de douleurs comme une femme qui accouche.
fr.R: Ils ont tremblé de peur. Ils avaient mal comme une femme qui met au monde un bébé.

sw.L: Kutetemeka kuliwashika huko, uchungu kama [wa mwanamke] anayezaa.
sw.B: Huko walishikwa na kutetemeka, na maumivu kama ya mwanamke anayejifungua.
sw.R: Walitetemeka kwa hofu. Waliumia kama mwanamke anayezaa mtoto.

es.L: Allí los tomó el temblor, dolor como de [mujer] que da a luz.
es.B: Allí se apoderó de ellos un temblor, con dolores como los de una mujer de parto.
es.R: Temblaban de miedo. Sentían dolor como una mujer que está dando a luz.

vi.L: Sự run rẩy đã chụp lấy chúng tại đó, đau đớn như [người đàn bà] sinh nở.
vi.B: Tại đó chúng bị cơn run rẩy chụp lấy, quặn đau như người đàn bà sinh con.
vi.R: Chúng run lên vì sợ hãi. Chúng đau đớn như người phụ nữ sắp sinh con.

ko.L: 거기서 떨림이 그들을 사로잡았으니, 해산하는 [여인] 같은 고통이었다.
ko.B: 거기서 그들은 떨림에 사로잡혔으니, 해산하는 여인이 겪는 진통 같았다.
ko.R: 그들은 무서워서 떨었다. 아기를 낳는 여인처럼 고통스러워했다.

pt.L: Tremor os tomou ali, angústia como [a de uma mulher] dando à luz.
pt.B: Ali foram tomados de tremor, de dores como as de uma mulher que dá à luz.
pt.R: Eles tremeram de medo. Sentiram dor como uma mulher tendo um bebê.

am.B: በዚያም መንቀጥቀጥ ያዛቸው፤ እንደምትወልድ ሴት ምጥ ያዛቸው።

ru.B: Там их охватила дрожь, боли, как у женщины в родах.

ja.B: そこで、彼らは震えに捕らえられ、子を産む女のような激しい痛みに襲われた。
ja.R: 彼らは恐ろしさに震えた。子どもを産む女の人のように苦しんだ。

decisions.choice: anguish like a woman giving birth: sudden, helpless terror

decisions.choice: there: at the sight of the city
decisions.reason: "There" places their terror at the city itself, at the moment they saw it.

vi.L: Bằng ngọn gió đông, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đập tan các tàu Ta-rê-si.

ko.B: 동쪽에서 부는 바람으로 주님께서 다시스의 배들을 부수십니다.
ko.R: 사막에서 불어오는 거센 바람이 큰 배들을 산산조각 내듯이, 주님께서 그들을 부수셨습니다.

pt.L: Com um vento oriental {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} despedaças [os] navios de Társis.
pt.B: Com um vento do oriente {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} destróis os navios de Társis.
pt.R: Tu os despedaçaste como um vento forte vindo do deserto arrebenta grandes navios de alto-mar.

am.B: ከምሥራቅ በሚነፍስ ነፋስ የተርሴስን መርከቦች ታጠፋለህ።

ja.L: 東風によって、あなたはタルシシュの船を打ち砕かれる。
ja.B: あなたは東からの風で、タルシシュの船を打ち砕かれる。

decisions.choice: you shatter: the psalm turns to God
alternatives: a comparison: as you shatter the ships of Tarshish, so you broke the kings
decisions.reason: The psalm suddenly speaks to God. The line may describe another of his deeds or picture the kings' defeat: they were broken as ships are wrecked in a storm.

decisions.choice: ships of Tarshish: great seagoing ships
decisions.reason: Tarshish was a distant port in the far west; "ships of Tarshish" were the largest ships, built for long voyages (1 Kings 10:22; Isaiah 2:16). They were a picture of human pride and strength.

decisions.choice: an east wind: a violent wind from the desert
decisions.reason: The east wind blows hot and strong from the desert; God uses it to act (Exodus 14:21; Ezekiel 27:26).

decisions.choice: You broke them up the way ...
decisions.reason: Readable takes the line as a comparison (m1), so that it connects with the story of the kings.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for "you" as the psalm turns to speak to God
decisions.reason: The psalm turns here from speaking about God to speaking to him (see the meaning decision). As in Psalm 23:4, "Ngài" serves for "you", with the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: The psalm turns to speak to God in 합쇼체, addressing him by title, "주님" (verses 8, 10-12); the singers are "저희"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to address God here (meaning decision m1). Style guide section 7a: the psalmist speaks to God in 합쇼체 and addresses him by title, not by a pronoun; there are no deity_pronoun spans in Korean.

decisions.reason: Tarshish as in Kings (1KI-3 notes); great seagoing ships (m2) and a violent desert wind (m3), explained at R as the English R.

decisions.choice: as we heard, so we have seen
decisions.reason: The stories of what God did in the past (44:2) have now been seen with their own eyes, in the rescue of the city.

decisions.choice: establish: make firm, keep standing
decisions.reason: The verb (kun) means to set firmly in place. The city's lasting is God's work.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: The title (YHWH tseba'ot) names the LORD as commander of the armies of heaven, his angels and the stars (1 Kings 22:19; Isaiah 40:26), and of Israel's army (1 Samuel 17:45). Literal keeps the older "hosts"; Balanced and Readable say "Armies", as in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: it
decisions.reason: As in 46:6.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Sê-la" kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The word's meaning is no longer known; it is probably a musical direction (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Verse 9 is set in 합쇼체 like the address to God around it, though God is spoken of in the third person
decisions.reason: Verses 8 and 10 are spoken to God; Korean keeps one speech level through the address so the voice does not change in the middle, and speaks of God with the honorific.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДА Саваофа" (L, B); "ГОСПОДА Воинств" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 46:8, the history note's forms for YHWH of hosts.

decisions.choice: "его" for the city
decisions.reason: As in 46:6: Russian "город" is masculine, so the pronoun follows it where the Hebrew and the English Literal say "her".

records.literal_gloss: We have pondered, God, your loyal love in [the] midst of your temple.

en.L: We have pondered, God, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love in the midst of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} temple.
en.B: God, we have reflected on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love here inside {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} temple.
en.R: God, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} temple we think about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love.

fr.L: Nous avons médité, Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal au milieu de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} temple.
fr.B: Dieu, nous avons médité sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, ici, dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} temple.
fr.R: Dieu, dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} temple, nous pensons à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle.

sw.L: Tumetafakari, Ee Mungu, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma katikati ya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, tumeutafakari upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma hapa ndani ya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.R: Ee Mungu, ndani ya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} tunafikiri juu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma.

es.L: Hemos meditado, oh Dios, en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal en medio de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} templo.
es.B: Dios, aquí dentro de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} templo hemos reflexionado sobre {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel.
es.R: Dios, en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} templo pensamos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel.

vi.L: Chúng tôi đã suy ngẫm, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở giữa đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, chúng tôi đã suy ngẫm về tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngay trong đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, trong đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng tôi suy nghĩ về tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 하나님, 저희가 주님의 성전 한가운데서 주님의 한결같은 사랑을 깊이 생각하였습니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 저희가 주님의 성전 안에서 주님의 한결같은 사랑을 되새겼습니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 저희는 주님의 성전에서 주님의 변함없는 사랑을 생각합니다.

pt.L: Meditamos, ó Deus, no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal no meio do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} templo.
pt.B: Ó Deus, aqui dentro do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} templo refletimos sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal.
pt.R: Ó Deus, no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} templo pensamos no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ በመቅደስህ መካከል ጽኑ ፍቅርህን አሰብን።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ በዚህ በመቅደስህ ውስጥ ጽኑ ፍቅርህን አሰላሰልን።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ በመቅደስህ ውስጥ ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ እናስባለን።

hi.L: हे परमेश्वर, हमने तेरे मन्दिर के बीच में तेरे अटल प्रेम पर मनन किया है।
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, यहाँ तेरे मन्दिर के भीतर हमने तेरे अटल प्रेम पर विचार किया है।
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, तेरे मन्दिर में हम तेरे अटल प्रेम के बारे में सोचते हैं।

ru.L: Мы размышляли, Боже, о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви посреди {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} храма.
ru.B: Боже, мы размышляли о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви здесь, в {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} храме.
ru.R: Боже, в {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} храме мы думаем о {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви.

ja.L: わたしたちは思い巡らした、神よ、あなたの誠実を、あなたの神殿の中で。
ja.B: 神よ、わたしたちは、あなたの神殿の中で、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみを思い巡らしてきた。
ja.R: 神よ、わたしたちは、あなたの神殿で、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみのことを考える。

uk.L: Ми роздумували, Боже, про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} незмінну любов посеред {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} храму.
uk.B: Боже, ми роздумували про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} незмінну любов тут, у {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} храмі.
uk.R: Боже, у {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} храмі ми думаємо про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} вірну любов.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8). The rescue of the city is an act of it.

decisions.choice: pondered: called to mind, thought over
decisions.reason: The verb (damah) means to picture or compare, and so to think over carefully.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: "amour loyal" (Literal), "amour fidèle" (Balanced, Readable) for hesed, for this block of psalms
decisions.reason: Hesed is love that keeps faith with a covenant (meaning decision m1). Literal says "loyal" to keep the covenant sense plain; Balanced and Readable say "fidèle", the more natural French. "Bonté" is kept for the places where the English says "kindness".

decisions.choice: "upendo usiokoma" (love that does not stop) for hesed at every level; "fadhili" where the English has "kindness"
decisions.reason: The English has "loyal love" (L, B) and "faithful love" (R). "Upendo usiokoma" says the love and its faithfulness together and is the form set for Psalms; "fadhili" (kindness, favour) is kept for the places where the English says "kindness".

decisions.choice: amor leal (L); amor fiel (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word (chesed) is love that keeps faith with a bond. Literal says "amor leal", Balanced and Readable "amor fiel", the forms settled for these books; "misericordia" would make it pity rather than loyalty.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R), as Psalm 23:6
decisions.reason: The word is love that keeps faith (see the meaning decision); the forms are those of Psalm 23:6, kept through the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "chúng tôi" when the worshipers speak to God
decisions.reason: Speaking to God, the worshipers say "chúng tôi", which leaves out the one addressed; "chúng ta" is kept for verses where they speak about God among themselves.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B) and "변함없는 사랑" (R) for the Hebrew hesed
decisions.reason: As the published Psalm 23:6 and the terms note: love that keeps faith with a covenant (meaning decision m1). "인자" is the older church word; it stays for "kindness" where the English has that. This holds through these psalms.

decisions.choice: "неизменная любовь" at every level
decisions.reason: As in 42:9, the poetry note's word for God's hesed, Readable included.

decisions.choice: chasdekha "あなたの誠実" (L), "あなたの変わらぬいつくしみ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Psalter's hesed forms (PSA-1).

source.text: כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Like your name, God, so your praise [is] to [the] ends of [the] earth; righteousness fills your right hand.

en.L: Like {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, God, so [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise to the ends of [the] earth; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand is full of righteousness.
en.B: Your praise, God, matches {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name and spreads to the far ends of the earth; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand overflows with justice.
en.R: God, people praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} all over the world, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name is known everywhere. Everything {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do is right and fair.

fr.L: Comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, Dieu, ainsi [est] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange jusqu’aux extrémités de [la] terre ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite est pleine de justice.
fr.B: Ta louange, Dieu, est à la mesure de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom et s’étend jusqu’aux extrémités de la terre ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main droite est pleine de justice.
fr.R: Dieu, on {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loue dans le monde entier, comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est connu partout. Tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais est juste et droit.

sw.L: Kama jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee Mungu, ndivyo sifa {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [ilivyo] hadi miisho ya dunia; mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume umejaa haki.
sw.B: Sifa {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Ee Mungu, inalingana na jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, na inaenea mpaka miisho ya dunia; mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume umejaa haki tele.
sw.R: Ee Mungu, watu wanakusifu ulimwenguni kote, kama jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} linavyojulikana kila mahali. Kila kitu unachofanya ni cha haki na cha adili.

es.L: Como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, oh Dios, así [es] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza hasta los confines de [la] tierra; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} diestra está llena de justicia.
es.B: Tu alabanza, oh Dios, está a la altura de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre y llega hasta los extremos de la tierra; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano derecha rebosa de justicia.
es.R: Dios, la gente {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alaba en todo el mundo, así como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre es conocido en todas partes. Todo lo que haces es justo y recto.

vi.L: Như danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, thì sự ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [cũng vậy] đến tận cùng trái đất; tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đầy dẫy sự công chính.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xứng với danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và lan đến tận cùng trái đất; tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tràn đầy công lý.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, người ta ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khắp thế giới, cũng như danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được biết đến ở khắp nơi. Mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm đều đúng và công bằng.

ko.L: 하나님, 주님의 이름과 같이 주님을 찬양함도 땅끝까지 [이르고], 주님의 오른손에는 의가 가득합니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 주님을 찬양하는 소리가 주님의 이름에 걸맞게 땅끝까지 퍼지고, 주님의 오른손에는 정의가 넘칩니다.
ko.R: 하나님, 주님의 이름이 어디서나 알려진 것처럼, 온 세상 사람들이 주님을 찬양합니다. 주님께서 하시는 일은 모두 옳고 공정합니다.

pt.L: Como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, ó Deus, assim [é] o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} louvor até os confins da terra; a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão direita está cheia de justiça.
pt.B: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} louvor, ó Deus, está à altura do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome e se espalha até os confins da terra; a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão direita transborda de justiça.
pt.R: Ó Deus, as pessoas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvam no mundo inteiro, assim como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é conhecido em toda parte. Tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes é certo e justo.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ እንደ ስምህ እንዲሁ ምስጋናህ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ [ነው]፤ ቀኝ እጅህ ጽድቅን የተሞላ ነው።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ምስጋናህ እንደ ስምህ ነው፤ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻም ይደርሳል፤ ቀኝ እጅህ በጽድቅ የተትረፈረፈ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ስምህ በየስፍራው እንደ ታወቀ፣ ሰዎች በዓለም ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል። የምታደርገው ሁሉ ትክክልና ፍትሐዊ ነው።

hi.L: हे परमेश्वर, जैसा तेरा नाम [है], वैसी ही तेरी स्तुति पृथ्वी की छोर तक [है]; तेरा दाहिना हाथ धार्मिकता से भरा है।
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, तेरी स्तुति तेरे नाम के योग्य है और पृथ्वी के दूर-दूर के छोरों तक फैलती है; तेरा दाहिना हाथ न्याय से भरपूर है।
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, सारे संसार में लोग तेरी स्तुति करते हैं, जैसे तेरा नाम हर जगह जाना जाता है। तू जो कुछ करता है, वह सही और न्यायपूर्ण है।

ru.L: Как имя {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}}, Боже, так и хвала {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} — до краёв земли; праведности полна {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} правая рука.
ru.B: Хвала {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, Боже, достойна {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени и доходит до краёв земли; {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} правая рука полна справедливости.
ru.R: Боже, люди хвалят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} по всему миру, ведь {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя известно повсюду. Всё, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} делаешь, правильно и справедливо.

ja.L: あなたの名のように、神よ、そのように、あなたの賛美も地の果てにまで[及ぶ]。あなたの右の手は義に満ちている。
ja.B: 神よ、あなたの名にふさわしく、あなたへの賛美は地の果てにまで広がる。あなたの右の手は、義にあふれている。
ja.R: 神よ、あなたの名が世界中に知られているように、世界中の人々があなたを賛美する。あなたがなさることは、みな正しく公平だ。

uk.L: Як {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя, Боже, так і {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} хвала — до краю землі; {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} правиця повна праведності.
uk.B: Твоя хвала, Боже, рівна {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} імені й лунає до найдальших країв землі; {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} правиця переповнена справедливістю.
uk.R: Боже, люди хвалять {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} по всьому світу, так само як {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя відоме всюди. Усе, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} робиш, правильне й справедливе.

decisions.choice: your name: who you are, your reputation
decisions.reason: God's name is what is known of him. His praise is as great, and reaches as far, as his name.

decisions.choice: your right hand: your power in action
decisions.reason: The right hand is the hand that acts, and God's acts are full of justice; here, his rescue of the city.

decisions.choice: Everything you do is right and fair
alternatives: your right hand is full of righteousness
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).

decisions.choice: tsedeq "義" (L, B), "正しく公平" (R)
decisions.reason: tsedeq 義 (L, B), R by sense (PSA-1); the right hand is power in action (m2).

source.text: יִשְׂמַ֤ח׀הַר־צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let Mount Zion rejoice; let [the] daughters of Judah be glad because of your judgments.

en.L: Let Mount Zion rejoice; let the daughters of Judah be glad because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments.
en.B: Let Mount Zion be glad, and the towns of Judah celebrate, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} judge rightly.
en.R: So let the people on Mount Zion be happy! Let the towns of Judah celebrate, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have judged fairly.

fr.L: Que le mont Sion se réjouisse ; que les filles de Juda soient dans l’allégresse à cause de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements.
fr.B: Que le mont Sion se réjouisse, que les villes de Juda soient en fête, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juges avec justice.
fr.R: Que les gens du mont Sion soient heureux ! Que les villes de Juda fassent la fête, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as jugé avec justice.

sw.L: Mlima Sayuni na ufurahi; binti za Yuda na washangilie kwa sababu ya hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Mlima Sayuni na ufurahi, na miji ya Yuda ishangilie, kwa sababu unahukumu kwa haki.
sw.R: Basi watu wa Mlima Sayuni na wafurahi! Miji ya Yuda na isherehekee, kwa sababu umehukumu kwa haki.

es.L: Alégrese el monte Sion; regocíjense las hijas de Judá a causa de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} juicios.
es.B: Que se alegre el monte Sion, y que celebren los pueblos de Judá, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} juzgas con rectitud.
es.R: ¡Que se alegre la gente del monte Sion! Que celebren los pueblos de Judá, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has juzgado con justicia.

vi.L: Nguyện núi Si-ôn vui mừng; nguyện các con gái Giu-đa hân hoan vì các sự phán xét của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nguyện núi Si-ôn vui mừng, và các thành của Giu-đa hân hoan, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử công minh.
vi.R: Vậy hãy để dân chúng trên núi Si-ôn vui mừng! Hãy để các thành của Giu-đa ăn mừng, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xét xử công bằng.

ko.L: 주님의 판단들 때문에 시온산이 기뻐하고, 유다의 딸들이 즐거워하게 하십시오.
ko.B: 주님께서 바르게 판단하시니, 시온산이 기뻐하고 유다의 성읍들이 즐거워하게 하십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서 공정하게 심판하셨으니, 시온산의 사람들이 기뻐하게 하십시오! 유다의 성읍들이 즐거워하게 하십시오!

pt.L: Alegre-se o monte Sião; regozijem-se as filhas de Judá por causa dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} juízos.
pt.B: Que o monte Sião se alegre, e as cidades de Judá façam festa, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} julgas com retidão.
pt.R: Por isso, que o povo do monte Sião fique feliz! Que as cidades de Judá façam festa, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} julgaste com justiça.

am.L: የጽዮን ተራራ ደስ ይበለው፤ ከፍርድህ የተነሣ የይሁዳ ሴቶች ልጆች ሐሤት ያድርጉ።
am.B: የጽዮን ተራራ ደስ ይበለው፤ የይሁዳ ከተሞችም በትክክል ስለምትፈርድ ሐሤት ያድርጉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ በጽዮን ተራራ ያሉ ሰዎች ደስ ይበላቸው! በትክክል ስለ ፈረድህ የይሁዳ ከተሞች ይደሰቱ።

hi.L: सिय्योन पर्वत आनंदित हो; यहूदा की बेटियाँ तेरे न्याय के कामों के कारण मगन हों।
hi.B: सिय्योन पर्वत आनंद करे, और यहूदा के नगर उत्सव मनाएँ, क्योंकि तू सही न्याय करता है।
hi.R: इसलिए सिय्योन पर्वत के लोग आनंदित हों! यहूदा के नगर उत्सव मनाएँ, क्योंकि तूने न्याय से फ़ैसला किया है।

ru.L: Пусть радуется гора Сион, пусть веселятся дочери Иуды из-за {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} судов.
ru.B: Пусть радуется гора Сион и ликуют города Иуды, потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} судишь справедливо.
ru.R: Пусть радуются люди на горе Сион! Пусть празднуют города Иуды, потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} рассудил справедливо.

ja.L: シオンの山は喜ぶがよい。ユダの娘たちは、あなたの裁きのゆえに楽しむがよい。
ja.B: シオンの山は喜び、ユダの町々は楽しむがよい。あなたが正しく裁かれるからだ。
ja.R: だから、シオンの山の人々は喜ぶがいい！ユダの町々は祝うがいい！あなたが公平に裁いてくださったからだ。

uk.L: Нехай радіє гора Сіон; нехай веселяться дочки Юди через {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} присуди.
uk.B: Нехай радіє гора Сіон, і нехай святкують міста Юди, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} судиш справедливо.
uk.R: Тож нехай люди на горі Сіон будуть щасливі! Нехай святкують міста Юди, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} судив справедливо.

decisions.choice: the daughters of Judah: the towns of Judah
decisions.reason: Towns around a capital were called its "daughters" (Numbers 21:25, where "its villages" is literally "its daughters"). It may also mean the women of Judah, who led the songs of victory (1 Samuel 18:6).

decisions.choice: your judgments: your just verdicts and acts
decisions.reason: God's judgments are his decisions as judge, here the defeat of the kings who came against Zion.

decisions.choice: the towns of Judah
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the likelier sense (m1).

decisions.choice: Literal keeps "유다의 딸들" (the daughters of Judah); Balanced and Readable "유다의 성읍들" (the towns of Judah)
decisions.reason: The daughters of Judah are its towns (meaning decision m1), as the English Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: benot Yehudah "ユダの娘たち" (L), "ユダの町々" (B, R); mishpatekha "あなたの裁き" (L), "正しく裁かれる" (B)
decisions.reason: The daughters of Judah read as its towns (m1, uncertain); your just verdicts and acts (m2). The wish takes 〜がよい / 〜がいい, as a call to third persons.

records.literal_gloss: Go around Zion and circle her; count her towers;

en.L: Go around Zion and circle her; count her towers,
en.B: Make a circuit of Zion and walk all the way around; count up its towers,
en.R: Walk all the way around Zion. Count its towers.

fr.L: Faites le tour de Sion et parcourez-la en cercle ; comptez ses tours,
fr.B: Faites le tour de Sion, faites-en le tour complet ; comptez ses tours,
fr.R: Faites tout le tour de Sion. Comptez ses tours.

sw.L: Zungukeni Sayuni, mzunguke pande zote; hesabuni minara yake,
sw.B: Tembeeni kuizunguka Sayuni, mpaka mwisho wa mzunguko; hesabuni minara yake,
sw.R: Tembeeni kuizunguka Sayuni yote. Hesabuni minara yake.

es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} la vuelta a Sion y {{plural_you:recórranla|recorredla}} toda; {{plural_you:cuenten|contad}} sus torres,
es.R: {{plural_you:Caminen|Caminad}} alrededor de toda Sion. {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} sus torres.

vi.L: Hãy đi quanh Si-ôn và đi vòng quanh thành; hãy đếm các tháp canh của thành,
vi.B: Hãy đi một vòng quanh Si-ôn, đi khắp chung quanh; hãy đếm các tháp canh của thành,
vi.R: Hãy đi một vòng quanh Si-ôn. Hãy đếm các tháp canh của thành.

ko.L: 시온을 돌고 그 둘레를 돌아라. 그 망대들을 세어 보아라.
ko.B: 시온을 한 바퀴 빙 둘러 걸으며 그 망대들을 세어 보아라.
ko.R: 시온 둘레를 한 바퀴 걸어 보아라. 망대들을 세어 보아라.

pt.L: Andem ao redor de Sião e a rodeiem; contem as suas torres,
pt.B: Deem uma volta por Sião, andem ao redor dela toda; contem as suas torres,
pt.R: Andem em volta de Sião inteira. Contem as suas torres.

am.B: ጽዮንን ዞራችሁ ተመልከቱ፤ ዙሪያዋንም ሁሉ ሂዱ፤ ግንቦቿን ቁጠሩ፤
am.R: በጽዮን ዙሪያ ሁሉ ተመላለሱ። ግንቦቿን ቁጠሩ።

hi.L: सिय्योन के चारों ओर चलो और उसे घेरकर घूमो; उसके गुम्मटों को गिनो,
hi.B: सिय्योन का चक्कर लगाओ और उसके चारों ओर पूरा घूमो; उसकी मीनारों को गिनो,
hi.R: सिय्योन के चारों ओर पूरा चक्कर लगाओ। उसकी मीनारों को गिनो।

ru.L: Обойдите Сион и окружите его; сосчитайте башни его,
ru.B: Пройдите вокруг Сиона, обойдите его кругом; пересчитайте его башни,
ru.R: Обойдите вокруг всего Сиона. Сосчитайте его башни.

ja.L: シオンを巡り、その周りを歩け。その塔を数えよ、
ja.B: シオンを巡り、ぐるりと歩いて回り、その塔を数えなさい。
ja.R: シオンの周りを、ぐるりと歩きなさい。その塔を数えなさい。

uk.L: Обійдіть Сіон і оточіть його; полічіть його вежі,
uk.B: Обійдіть довкола Сіону, пройдіть його кругом; полічіть його вежі,
uk.R: Обійдіть увесь Сіон довкола. Полічіть його вежі.

decisions.choice: go around, count: an invitation to look
decisions.reason: The pilgrims are invited to walk around the city and see it is whole, though kings came against it. The sentence runs on to verse 15.

decisions.choice: it, its
decisions.reason: As in 46:6.

decisions.choice: "hãy" with no pronoun for the plural command
decisions.reason: The call goes to all who hear the psalm; Vietnamese leaves the plural subject unspoken, which suits a summons to the whole people.

decisions.choice: From verse 13 the singers speak to the listeners in 해라체 (돌아라, 세어 보아라)
decisions.reason: The invitation to walk round the city is spoken to the worshipers (meaning decision m1), not to God, so Korean uses the plain imperative.

decisions.choice: Commands to the hearers "歩け" / "数えよ" (L), "〜なさい" (B, R); 48:13-15 one sentence at L as the English
decisions.reason: The psalmist's commands to people (PSA-1); an invitation to look (m1).

source.text: שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם׀לְֽחֵילָ֗ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: set your heart to her rampart; go through her fortresses, so that you may recount [it] to a later generation,

en.L: set your heart on her rampart; pass through her fortresses, so that you may recount [it] to a later generation,
en.B: take careful note of its walls, walk through its strongholds, so that you can tell the generation to come
en.R: Look closely at its walls. Go through its strong buildings. Then you can tell the people who come after you about it.

fr.L: mettez votre cœur à son rempart ; passez par ses palais fortifiés, afin de [le] raconter à une génération future,
fr.B: regardez bien ses remparts, parcourez ses citadelles, afin de pouvoir dire à la génération qui vient
fr.R: Regardez bien ses murs. Passez dans ses bâtiments solides. Alors vous pourrez en parler à ceux qui viendront après vous.

sw.L: wekeni mioyo yenu kwenye boma lake; piteni katika ngome zake, ili mpate kusimulia [habari] kwa kizazi kijacho,
sw.B: angalieni kwa makini kuta zake, tembeeni katika ngome zake, ili mweze kukieleza kizazi kijacho
sw.R: Angalieni kwa makini kuta zake. Piteni katikati ya majengo yake imara. Ndipo mtaweza kuwaeleza watu watakaokuja baada yenu habari zake.

es.L: {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón en su muralla; {{plural_you:recorran|recorred}} sus fortalezas, para que {{plural_you:cuenten|contéis}} [esto] a la generación venidera,
es.B: {{plural_you:fíjense|fijaos}} bien en sus murallas, {{plural_you:recorran|recorred}} sus fortalezas, para que {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}} contar a la generación que viene
es.R: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} con atención sus murallas. {{plural_you:Recorran|Recorred}} sus edificios fuertes. Así {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} contárselo a los que vengan después.

vi.L: hãy để lòng vào thành lũy của thành; hãy đi qua các đồn lũy của thành, để các người có thể thuật lại cho thế hệ sau,
vi.B: hãy để ý kỹ tường thành, hãy đi qua các đồn lũy, để có thể kể lại cho thế hệ mai sau
vi.R: Hãy nhìn kỹ các bức tường. Hãy đi qua các tòa nhà kiên cố. Rồi các bạn có thể kể về thành cho những người đến sau.

ko.L: 그 성벽에 너희 마음을 두고, 그 요새들을 지나가 보아라. 너희가 다음 세대에게 [그것을] 전하기 위해서이다.
ko.B: 그 성벽을 눈여겨보고 그 요새들을 두루 다녀 보아라. 그리하여 다음 세대에게 전하여라.
ko.R: 성벽을 자세히 살펴보아라. 튼튼한 건물들을 지나가 보아라. 그러면 너희 뒤에 올 사람들에게 이것을 이야기해 줄 수 있을 것이다.

pt.L: ponham o coração na sua muralha; percorram as suas fortalezas, para que [o] relatem a uma geração futura,
pt.B: observem com atenção as suas muralhas, percorram as suas fortalezas, para que possam contar à geração que vem
pt.R: Olhem com atenção as suas muralhas. Andem pelos seus prédios fortes. Então vocês poderão falar sobre ela às pessoas que vierem depois de vocês.

am.L: ልባችሁን በቅጥሯ ላይ አኑሩ፤ በምሽጎቿ መካከል እለፉ፤ ለሚመጣው ትውልድ ትነግሩ ዘንድ፣
am.B: ቅጥሮቿን በጥንቃቄ ተመልከቱ፤ በምሽጎቿ መካከል ተመላለሱ፤ ለሚመጣውም ትውልድ እንድትነግሩ፣
am.R: ቅጥሮቿን በጥንቃቄ ተመልከቱ። በጠንካራ ሕንፃዎቿ መካከል ሂዱ። ከዚያም ከእናንተ በኋላ ለሚመጡት ሰዎች ስለ እርሷ ትነግራላችሁ።

hi.L: उसकी शहरपनाह पर मन लगाओ; उसके गढ़ों में से होकर निकलो, ताकि तुम आनेवाली पीढ़ी को [उसका] वर्णन कर सको,
hi.B: उसकी दीवारों पर ध्यान से नज़र डालो, उसके गढ़ों में से होकर चलो, ताकि तुम आनेवाली पीढ़ी को बता सको
hi.R: उसकी दीवारों को ध्यान से देखो। उसकी मज़बूत इमारतों में से होकर जाओ। तब तुम अपने बाद आनेवाले लोगों को उसके बारे में बता सकोगे।

ru.L: обратите сердце ваше к валу его; пройдите по крепостям его, чтобы вы рассказали [об этом] поколению последующему,
ru.B: внимательно рассмотрите его стены, пройдите по его укреплениям, чтобы вы могли рассказать грядущему поколению
ru.R: Посмотрите внимательно на его стены. Пройдите по его крепким строениям. Тогда вы сможете рассказать о нём тем, кто будет жить после вас.

ja.L: その城壁に心を留め、その城塞をめぐり歩け。後の世代に語り伝えるために、
ja.B: その城壁をよく見、その城塞を巡り歩きなさい。後に来る世代に語り伝えることができるように。
ja.R: その城壁をよく見なさい。その堅固な建物の中を通りなさい。そうすれば、あとから来る人々に、そのことを話してやれる。

uk.L: покладіть своє серце на його вал; пройдіть його твердинями, щоб ви розповіли [це] пізнішому поколінню,
uk.B: уважно розгляньте його мури, пройдіть його твердинями, щоб ви могли розповісти прийдешньому поколінню,
uk.R: Придивіться до його мурів. Пройдіть його міцними будівлями. Тоді ви зможете розповісти про це людям, які прийдуть після вас.

decisions.choice: set your heart: pay close attention
decisions.reason: To set the heart on something is to give it careful attention.

decisions.choice: go through: walk among, view
decisions.reason: The verb (pasag) occurs only here; it seems to mean to pass between or inspect.

decisions.choice: rampart: the outer wall
decisions.reason: The word (chel) is the outer wall or rampart that circles a city.

decisions.choice: its
decisions.reason: As in 46:6.

decisions.choice: shitu libbekhem "心を留め" (L), "よく見" (B, R); pasgu "めぐり歩け" (L)
decisions.reason: Pay close attention (m1); the rare verb pissgu read as walking among them (m2, uncertain).

source.text: כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה׀אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל־מֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: that this [is] God, our God forever and ever; he will guide us until death.

en.L: that this [is] God, our God forever and ever; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will guide us until death.
en.B: that this is God, our God forever and always; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be our guide until we die.
en.R: Tell them that this is our God for all time. He will lead us as long as we live.

fr.L: que celui-ci [est] Dieu, notre Dieu pour toujours et à jamais ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous guidera jusqu’à la mort.
fr.B: que tel est Dieu, notre Dieu pour toujours et à jamais ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera notre guide jusqu’à notre mort.
fr.R: Dites-leur que c’est notre Dieu pour toujours. Il nous conduira toute notre vie.

sw.L: ya kwamba huyu [ndiye] Mungu, Mungu wetu milele na milele; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atatuongoza hadi kifo.
sw.B: kwamba huyu ndiye Mungu, Mungu wetu milele na daima; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakuwa kiongozi wetu mpaka tufe.
sw.R: Waambieni kwamba huyu ndiye Mungu wetu siku zote. Atatuongoza maisha yetu yote.

es.L: que este [es] Dios, nuestro Dios por siempre y para siempre; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos guiará hasta la muerte.
es.B: que este es Dios, nuestro Dios por siempre jamás; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} será nuestro guía hasta que muramos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Díganles|Decidles}} que este es nuestro Dios para siempre. Él nos guiará mientras vivamos.

vi.L: rằng đây [là] Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta đến đời đời mãi mãi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ dẫn dắt chúng ta cho đến chết.
vi.B: rằng đây là Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta đời đời mãi mãi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ dẫn dắt chúng ta cho đến khi chúng ta qua đời.
vi.R: Hãy nói với họ rằng đây là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta mãi mãi. Ngài sẽ dẫn dắt chúng ta suốt cuộc đời.

ko.L: 이분이 하나님, 영원무궁토록 우리의 하나님이시라는 것을. 그분께서 죽을 때까지 우리를 인도하실 것이다.
ko.B: 이분이 하나님, 영원토록 우리의 하나님이시다. 그분께서 우리가 죽을 때까지 우리를 인도하실 것이다.
ko.R: 이분이 언제까지나 우리 하나님이시라고 말해 주어라. 그분께서 우리가 사는 날 동안 우리를 이끌어 주실 것이다.

pt.L: que este [é] Deus, o nosso Deus para todo o sempre; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos guiará até a morte.
pt.B: que este é Deus, o nosso Deus para todo o sempre; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} será o nosso guia até morrermos.
pt.R: Contem a elas que este é o nosso Deus para sempre. Ele vai nos guiar enquanto vivermos.

am.L: ይህ እግዚአብሔር፣ ለዘላለም ዓለም አምላካችን እንደ ሆነ፤ እርሱ እስከ ሞት ድረስ ይመራናል።
am.B: ይህ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለምና ለሁልጊዜ አምላካችን እንደ ሆነ፤ እስክንሞት ድረስ መሪያችን ይሆናል።
am.R: ይህ ለዘላለም አምላካችን እንደ ሆነ ንገሯቸው። በሕይወት እስካለን ድረስ ይመራናል።

hi.L: कि यह परमेश्वर, युगानुयुग हमारे परमेश्वर [हैं]; वे मृत्यु तक हमारी अगुवाई करेंगे।
hi.B: कि यही परमेश्वर हैं, सदा-सर्वदा के लिए हमारे परमेश्वर; वे मृत्यु तक हमारे मार्गदर्शक रहेंगे।
hi.R: उन्हें बताओ कि यही सदा के लिए हमारे परमेश्वर हैं। जब तक हम जीवित हैं, वे हमारी अगुवाई करेंगे।

ru.L: что это — Бог, Бог наш во веки веков; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} будет вести нас до смерти.
ru.B: что это — Бог, наш Бог навсегда и навеки; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} будет нашим вожатым до самой смерти.
ru.R: Скажите им, что это наш Бог на все времена. Он будет вести нас всю нашу жизнь.

ja.L: これこそ神、とこしえにいつまでも、わたしたちの神であると。その方は死に至るまで、わたしたちを導かれる。
ja.B: これこそ神、世々限りなく、わたしたちの神である、と。その方は、わたしたちが死ぬまで、わたしたちを導いてくださる。
ja.R: こう話してやりなさい。これこそ、いつまでも、わたしたちの神だ。その方は、わたしたちが生きているかぎり、わたしたちを導いてくださる。

uk.L: що це — Бог, наш Бог на віки вічні; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вестиме нас аж до смерті.
uk.B: що це — Бог, наш Бог навіки й назавжди; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} буде нашим провідником, доки ми не помремо.
uk.R: Скажіть їм, що це наш Бог на всі часи. Він вестиме нас, доки ми живі.

decisions.choice: this is God: the God seen in the city
decisions.reason: "This" points to all they have seen: the city standing and its enemies gone show what God is like. He is "our God" for all time.

decisions.choice: until death: as long as we live
decisions.reason: The words ('al-mut) read "until death": God guides his people all their lives. With different vowels they would be "forever", which the ancient Greek translation has; others take them as a musical note like alamoth (46:1), belonging to the title of the next psalm.

decisions.choice: Tell them
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and repeats what the people are to tell (verse 14).

decisions.choice: 'al-mut "死に至るまで" (L), "わたしたちが死ぬまで" (B), "生きているかぎり" (R)
decisions.reason: Until death, as long as we live (m2, uncertain, footnoted); other readings take the word with the next psalm's title.
